content.title: GROCERY STORE NUTRIENT SWAPS {{NOBODY}} TELLS YOU ABOUT
facts: **Guava** has nearly four times more vitamin C than an orange, yet almost nobody buys it.
**Swiss chard** carries more magnesium per cup than a serving of spinach, and it's usually cheaper.
**Dried apricots** pack more potassium than a banana, gram for gram, once you dry them out.
**Lentils** hold more iron per cup than a beef burger patty, without the saturated fat.
**Parsnips** contain more fiber than a slice of whole wheat bread, hiding in a boring root veggie.
**Kale** delivers more vitamin K in one cup than a week's worth of most people's diets combined.
**Oysters** contain more zinc in a single serving than a whole day's worth of red meat.
**Mushrooms left in sunlight** for 30 minutes can build up more vitamin D than a glass of fortified milk.
**Sesame seeds** hold more calcium per tablespoon than a splash of milk in your coffee.
**Mustard seeds** carry more selenium than a can of tuna, ounce for ounce.
**Walnuts** contain more omega-3 (ALA) per handful than a serving of salmon, plant-based and all.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
